'''Pad 583''' was a landing pad located on [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. An [[unidentified Rebel starship]] carrying [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] landed there during their mission to Vorzyd V.
